theorem lg_target {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (Φ : ZMod N → ℂ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (fun x => Φ ↑x) s := by
  apply LSeriesSummable.of_abs_convergent
  apply abs_convergent_of_terminating_at_zero
  apply terminating_at_zero_of_terminating_at_zero
  intro n
  have : Φ ↑n = 0 := by
    rw [ZMod.cast_zero]
    exact zero_map _
  exact this
